svg.desc: ScadaCraft OpenBridge widget: Area graph (live) (obc-area-graph, OpenBridge 1.0.0, Apache-2.0). Library: OpenBridge · Charts. Box 384x240 px, anchor at (0,0). Bindable properties: _pn_value (default 0, read): Process value _ps_unit (default '', read): Engineering unit _pn_points (default 60, read): Points kept in the live buffer (60 points at 1 s = last minute) _pn_interval (default 1, read): Sampling interval of the live buffer, seconds _ps_lineMode (default 'smooth', read): Line: smooth | straight | stepped _pb_grid (default true, read): Show grid
